current.text: Meleek Thomas is a 20-year-old rookie. Cleveland took him with the 34th pick in the 2026 draft after trading back from 29.
He was the top-ranked fantasy player of summer league. He averaged 26 points, 4 assists and 2 steals, shooting 50% from the field and 44% from three.
James Harden and Donovan Mitchell start in the Cleveland backcourt, which leaves no immediate role for him.
Cleveland lost Schroder, Ellis and Strus. The projected bench is Tyson, Merrill, Bryant, Tomlin and Porter, and Thomas is not on that list.
Experts do not know how he fits this season. One expects him to be a 27-minute third guard within two years.
Dynasty experts rate him well above his draft slot. One board has him at rookie rank 23 and says he would be 14 to 16 in a better situation. Another had him in its top 20.

durable.text: He is a guard from Arkansas. In college he shot 42% on threes, with good two-point and free throw percentages.
One expert likes his size and shooting and thinks he can pass more and defend solidly. In this view, playing next to high-usage Darius Acuff held down his college numbers.
Experts say he has a high ceiling and expect him to become a starting-caliber NBA player.

note: Thomas is not a pick in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 623 with a value of 0 USD and projects only 5.6 points in 47 games, and ESPN does not price him at all. Watch him on waivers early in the season: Cleveland's bench is thin, so check whether he gets real minutes, mainly if Harden or Mitchell miss games.
